title: Institution
description: A built structure or endowed institution of the Islamic world: mosque, madrasa, shrine/türbe, hammam, caravanserai/han, palace, bridge, church, fountain/çeşme, market/bedesten, tekke, library, hospital/darüşşifa, observatory. Activated H11 (v0.4.0 set bump, ADR-015) to absorb ~4,800 building-class records held pending since H10 (Evliyâ + Konya + Cairo + Maqrīzī layers). Distinct from iac:Place: a place is a settlement/region; an institution is a STRUCTURE, normally located_in a place.

institution_subtype.description: Lower-cased discriminator mirroring the @type subtype (SQL-style filtering; the @type array carries the formal semantics).

located_in.description: The settlement this structure stands in (Tier-2 resolved; omitted when unresolved — never guessed).

patron_person.description: Founding/endowing patron, when resolvable to a canonical person.

derived_from_layers.description: Source layers that attest this structure (evliya-celebi, konya-city-atlas, cairo-city-atlas, maqrizi-khitat, ...).
